description: This file defines a servlet class UpdateAdmin that handles POST requests for updating administrator details in an online grocery ordering system. It processes form data, interacts with the database utility, and forwards responses based on success or failure.

classes.name: UpdateAdmin
classes.description: A servlet class responsible for handling the update of administrator details, including profile image, in the system.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update admin information, manages image upload, interacts with database utility methods, and forwards responses based on update success.
